controls.name: healthy boot environment and desktop preservation
controls.observed: Authenticated console selects the pre-update BE containing the same candidate. Encrypted boot/autologin and the unchanged published graphical helper pass; SDDM remains on VT9 for 93 seconds before deliberate failure injection.

controls.name: desktop-loss fallback and successful authenticated retry
controls.observed: Controlled SSH stop injects desktop loss without a VT switch. VNC observes the public menu after the crash grace period. Correct console authentication/retry restores the desktop; the same published helper passes again and the new SDDM survives 153 seconds before clean shutdown.
